blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 45 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (October 5, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: MATR & MRNA lead 45 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 26 Canadian and 19 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of October 5, 2026) found 45 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 26 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 16 of them new to the list this week. Mattr Corp. (MATR) leads with a +130% six-month return, and Industrials is the most represented sector with 12 names.

In the U.S., 19 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 6 of them new to the list this week. Moderna Inc. (MRNA) leads with a +289% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 9 names.
